name: Colour TFT display 2.8in 320x240 (ILI9341, SPI)
description: 2.8 in colour TFT, 240 x 320 pixels (320 x 240 in landscape), RGB565, on the ILI9341 controller over SPI. Uno wiring: VCC → 5V, GND → GND, CS → D10, DC → D9, RST → D8, MOSI → D11, SCK → D13, MISO → D12 (optional), LED → 5V or a PWM pin for the backlight. Works with Adafruit_ILI9341 (Adafruit_ILI9341 tft(10, 9, 8); tft.begin(); tft.setRotation(1);).

pins.label: VCC
pins.description: 3.3 to 5 V supply; the module has a 3.3 V regulator.

pins.label: CS
pins.description: Chip select, active low. Uno: D10 (any digital pin; pass it to the library).

pins.label: RESET
pins.description: Reset, active low, 10 kΩ pull-up on the module. Uno: D8, or leave unwired and pass -1 (the library then uses a software reset).

pins.label: DC/RS
pins.description: Data / command select: LOW = the SPI byte is a command, HIGH = parameter or pixel data. Uno: D9 (any digital pin).

pins.label: LED
pins.description: Backlight. HIGH (or unwired: 10 kΩ pull-up on the module) = on; analogWrite on a PWM pin dims it.

pins.label: SDO(MISO)
pins.description: SPI data out, only needed to read registers. Uno: D12.

props.label: Logic level
props.description: Breakouts with a level shifter (Adafruit 2.8in) take 5 V logic from an Uno. Bare red modules are 3.3 V logic: wiring them straight to 5 V pins is out of spec (add a 74HC4050 or series resistors).

footprint: 86 x 50 mm module, 9-pin 0.1 in header (VCC GND CS RESET DC SDI SCK LED SDO)

bindings.description: The glass shows an image: powered, sleep out (0x11), display on (0x29) and backlight on.
Backlight brightness 0..1 (LED pin level, or its PWM duty).
Counts visible changes; a renderer repaints when it changes. Pixels: Simulation.framebuffer(partId) (RGB565, 320 x 240, viewer orientation).
Frame width in pixels as drawn on the canvas (320).
Frame height in pixels as drawn on the canvas (240).
The Adafruit setRotation() value the MADCTL register matches (0..3, -1 for other settings). 1 and 3 are upright on the canvas.
Pixels that are not black (0 while the glass is dark). Handy in tests: expect tft.lit > 1000.
Near-white pixels (text boxes, speech bubbles). Handy in tests.
True when nothing is shown (dark glass or an all-black frame).
Controller in sleep mode (power-on default until SLPOUT 0x11).
Pixels written since power-on (counts redraws; useful to spot a sketch that repaints the whole screen every loop).
1 when the glass shows an image, 0 when dark (bound in the SVG).

mechanical.source: typical 2.8 in SPI module (active area 57.6 x 43.2 mm)
